title: Learning Clustering
subtitle: 连接与分组
Connections and groups
description: 从亲和度出发，理解单元如何合并成簇，再探索标签传播、谱方法与延迟导向聚类。
Start with affinity, learn how cells form clusters, then explore label propagation, spectral methods and delay-driven clustering.
author: Su3037
prerequisites: 基础图论；可从原站基础速查开始
Basic graph concepts; a foundations guide is available

title: Learning Partitioning
subtitle: 划分与取舍
Partition with purpose
description: 从割代价与平衡约束出发，构造和改进分组，再把二分扩展到递归与多路划分。
Measure cut cost and balance, construct and refine assignments, then extend bisection to recursive and k-way partitioning.
author: FanqinZeng
prerequisites: 基础图论；提供基础速查与浏览器 Python
Basic graph concepts; includes foundations and browser Python
